benefit_profiles.baseline: not measured - no instrument exists (recorded as a kata on the kata project)
benefit_profiles.capabilities: Tool platform (version, probe, binding, effect ceiling, ledger)
benefit_profiles.cost: T13 plus the absorption of the remaining services
kpis: zero-use toolkits retired after a programme cycle (P10)
benefit_profiles.measurement_method: The tool_call ledger's per-toolkit counts, read at the tranche review; retirement is a decision.
benefit_profiles.observable_outcome: Every cluster service a job may call is a versioned, bound, audited toolkit with a ledger.
benefit_profiles.risks: the unowned fleet keeps growing while toolkits wait
benefit_profiles.target: every service a job uses is a toolkit; a toolkit with no calls in a cycle is retired or justified

benefit_profiles.baseline: not measured - no instrument exists (recorded as a kata on the kata project)
benefit_profiles.capabilities: Development project (T6) on the PM job (T3) and the plan spine (T1)
benefit_profiles.cost: T6's tranche-11 build plus the CI budget
kpis: a development run reaches live verification with a recorded rollback
benefit_profiles.measurement_method: The development project's run, CI and deploy records; the lane and PR are the evidence.
objectives: O5 The conveyor develops and operates itself under its own gates
benefit_profiles.observable_outcome: A development project runs lane -> PR -> CI -> merge -> deploy -> live verify, with rollback, through the conveyor.
preconditions: CI runners and the deploy path
benefit_profiles.risks: the CI queue or a flaky gate makes the loop unusable
benefit_profiles.target: one self-development run reaches live verification on evidence; a second is repeatable

benefit_profiles.baseline: not measured - no instrument exists (recorded as a kata on the kata project)
benefit_profiles.capabilities: The public design site and the contribution path (issue forms, DCO, CONTRIBUTING)
benefit_profiles.cost: the site's maintenance and review time
kpis: an outside issue or PR that changes a published output
benefit_profiles.measurement_method: The GitHub issue registry and merged PR authors; the publications are recorded on the programme issues.
objectives: O6 The public can see and challenge the design
benefit_profiles.observable_outcome: An outside reader can read every published output, and an outside issue or PR changes the design.
benefit_profiles.target: at least one outside contribution changes a published output; every output is reachable

benefit_profiles.baseline: not measured - no instrument exists (recorded as a kata on the kata project)
kpis: no concept with two stores (the T0 gate)
benefit_profiles.measurement_method: The T0 gate test and the absorption inventory; a second store is a defect.
benefit_profiles.observable_outcome: A concept has one table and one action registry; no concept has two stores.
benefit_profiles.risks: a parallel store appears as a convenience
benefit_profiles.target: the T0 gate exists and refuses a second store; the registry has one home

benefit_profiles.baseline: not measured - no instrument exists (recorded as a kata on the kata project)
benefit_profiles.capabilities: The plan spine (T1) and the programme definition (P0)
benefit_profiles.cost: T1 and P0 plus the design-pack gates
kpis: the programme plan and the coverage instrument agree
benefit_profiles.measurement_method: coverage.json and seed/programme.json regenerated and checked in CI; the P0 checklist counts the published set.
benefit_profiles.observable_outcome: The programme plan's tranches, projects and expected outputs agree with the measured coverage and the published checklist.
benefit_profiles.risks: plan drift: a hand-written status rots
benefit_profiles.target: the seed, coverage and published checklist agree at every tranche review

stakeholder_profiles.benefits: every decision is auditable; the public collaboration
stakeholder_profiles.concerns: evidence, not claims; a refusal is honest
stakeholder_profiles.engagement_target: review each unit before publish; return or kata an incomplete output
stakeholder_profiles.name: Independent reviewers

stakeholder_profiles.concerns: the code and its gates are correct; the work is evidenced
stakeholder_profiles.engagement_target: build under the owner's authority; never self-approve; publish only as the admin decision the owner takes
stakeholder_profiles.name: Maintainer sessions (AI)
stakeholder_profiles.sensitivities: being asked to approve their own work

stakeholder_profiles.concerns: a clear design, a reviewable unit, a fair contribution path
stakeholder_profiles.engagement_target: GitHub issues, Discussions and forks; the Contribute page lists the ready units
stakeholder_profiles.name: Outside contributors

stakeholder_profiles.benefits: auditable decisions; one model; predictable delivery
stakeholder_profiles.concerns: the programme delivers the benefits it claims; the gates hold
stakeholder_profiles.disbenefits: the discipline of the gates slows a shortcut
stakeholder_profiles.engagement_target: the definition-set acceptance and each tranche review; owns P0's close
stakeholder_profiles.name: Sponsor / owner
stakeholder_profiles.sensitivities: an invented measurement or a self-approved change

stakeholder_profiles.benefits: the public can see and challenge the design
stakeholder_profiles.concerns: the programme is readable and the outputs are stable
stakeholder_profiles.engagement_target: the public site and each output's discussion link; no account
stakeholder_profiles.name: The public reader
stakeholder_profiles.sensitivities: a broken or missing output page

stakeholder_profiles.concerns: positions are staffed and bound; the releases are current
stakeholder_profiles.disbenefits: the transition from code paths to positions
stakeholder_profiles.engagement_target: the organisation seed and the job releases; the roles that own benefits and delivery
stakeholder_profiles.name: The tenant's jobs (the organisation)
stakeholder_profiles.sensitivities: a job with no release or a stale binding
